summary: Server singleton of esv::RewardManager: quest reward requests (esv::reward::RewardRequest) for this frame, created by RewardManager::CreateGiveRewardRequests from the manager's pending GiveRewardRequest list (character + quest id + quest step id), with the reward inventory, the items found in it and an additional gold amount. Read by esv::inventory::ManagementSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests. Seen.py context: singleton present in the idle level; samples after level-change held up to 4 elements.

fields.name: Character
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xD55B50 CreateGiveRewardRequests copies the entity of RewardManager's GiveRewardRequest (this+0xA8 array, stride 0x10) here; it is checked with CharacterComponent/uuid mapping before.

fields.name: QuestStepId
fields.evidence: FixedString passed to QuestManager::GetStepByID together with the quest id.

fields.name: field_11
fields.evidence: Set from QuestStep +0x7C != 0; forced to 1 when an additional gold reward is affordable or QuestStep +0x130 != -1.

fields.name: HasRewardInventory
fields.evidence: Set to 1 when eoc::inventory::GetInventory of the quest step's reward container returned a valid inventory (the entity stored at +0x18).

fields.name: Items
fields.evidence: 64 zeroed bytes copied by EoCServer.dll+0xD54550, whose asserts name IndexedStorage<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>> and IndexedStorage<unsigned short> (hash-table tag); filled by the ForEachEntityInInventory callback (ID, unsigned short) - items of the reward inventory and their amounts.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xD55B50 gets the singleton (EoCServer.dll+0xD50BD0, error path names GiveRewardRequestComponent) and appends elements with stride 0x68 (assert IndexedStorage<esv::reward::RewardRequest>). bg3.exe+0x30EFD60 allocates 0x10 (Array shape).

open_questions: Meaning of the two quest-step flags at +0x10/+0x11.
HashMap<EntityHandle, uint16_t> layout assumed standard (keys + values arrays) from the two asserts.
raw_check: 11 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
